13731:     function mfPersistUnitFinderDiagnostic(reason) {
13732:         const snapshot =
13733:             mfBuildUnitFinderDiagnosticSnapshot(reason);
13734: 
13735:         const hasUsefulData = !!(
13736:             snapshot.requirementContext.updatedAt ||
13737:             snapshot.requirementContext.suppliedRows.length ||
13738:             snapshot.requirementContext.processedRows.length ||
13739:             snapshot.requirementContext.currentLiveRequirementRows.length ||
13740:             snapshot.requirementContext.visibleAlerts.length ||
13741:             snapshot.selectionSummary.vehicleLoadState.rows.length ||
13742:             snapshot.selectionSummary.selectedVehicles.length
13743:         );
13744: 
13745:         if (!hasUsefulData) return snapshot;
13746: 
13747:         const emptyMissionUpdateSnapshot =
13748:             reason === 'not-ready' &&
13749:             snapshot.requirementContext.mode === 'mission-update' &&
13750:             snapshot.requirementContext.suppliedRows.length === 0 &&
13751:             snapshot.requirementContext.processedRows.length === 0 &&
13752:             snapshot.requirementContext.currentLiveRequirementRows.length === 0 &&
13753:             snapshot.requirementContext.visibleAlerts.length === 0 &&
13754:             snapshot.selectionSummary.vehicleLoadState.rows.length === 0;
13755: 
13756:         if (emptyMissionUpdateSnapshot) return snapshot;
13757: 
13758:         const signature = JSON.stringify({
13759:             mission: snapshot.mission.missionKey || snapshot.mission.missionId,
13760:             reason: snapshot.reason,
13761:             mode: snapshot.requirementContext.mode,
13762:             source: snapshot.requirementContext.sourceLabel,
13763:             ready: snapshot.execution.ready,
13764:             rows: snapshot.selectionSummary.vehicleLoadState.rows,
13765:             selected: snapshot.selectionSummary.selectedVehicles
13766:                 .map(vehicle => vehicle.vehicleId || vehicle.vehicleName)
13767:         });
13768: 
13769:         if (
13770:             signature === mfLastUnitFinderDiagnosticSignature &&
13771:             reason !== 'manual-export'
13772:         ) {
13773:             return snapshot;
13774:         }
13775: 
13776:         mfLastUnitFinderDiagnosticSignature = signature;
13777: 
13778:         const history = mfReadUnitFinderDiagnosticHistory();
13779:         history.push(snapshot);
13780: 
13781:         const boundedHistory =
13782:             mfBoundUnitFinderDiagnosticHistory(history);
13783: 
13784:         try {
13785:             localStorage.setItem(
13786:                 MF_UNIT_FINDER_DIAGNOSTICS_KEY,
13787:                 boundedHistory.encoded
13788:             );
13789:         } catch (_error) {
13790:             try {
13791:                 const fallback =
13792:                     mfBoundUnitFinderDiagnosticHistory(
13793:                         boundedHistory.history.slice(-4)
13794:                     );
13795: 
13796:                 localStorage.setItem(
13797:                     MF_UNIT_FINDER_DIAGNOSTICS_KEY,
13798:                     fallback.encoded
13799:                 );
13800:             } catch (_ignored) {}
13801:         }
13802: 
13803:         return snapshot;
13804:     }

16006:     function sortVehicleCheckboxesByBestArrival(matches) {
16007:         const getMetrics = input => {
16008:             const now = Date.now();
16009:             const cached = mfVehicleArrivalMetricCache.get(input);
16010: 
16011:             if (cached && now < cached.expiresAt) {
16012:                 return cached;
16013:             }
16014: 
16015:             const row = input?.closest?.('tr');
16016:             const metrics = {
16017:                 delay: parseFloat(
16018:                     row?.getAttribute('data-sortvalue') ||
16019:                     row?.getAttribute('timevalue') ||
16020:                     '999999'
16021:                 ),
16022:                 distance: parseFloat(
16023:                     row?.getAttribute('data-distance') ||
16024:                     '999999'
16025:                 ),
16026:                 expiresAt: now + 500
16027:             };
16028: 
16029:             mfVehicleArrivalMetricCache.set(input, metrics);
16030:             return metrics;
16031:         };
16032: 
16033:         matches.sort((a, b) => {
16034:             const metricsA = getMetrics(a);
16035:             const metricsB = getMetrics(b);
16036:             return (
16037:                 metricsA.delay - metricsB.delay ||
16038:                 metricsA.distance - metricsB.distance
16039:             );
16040:         });
16041: 
16042:         return matches;
16043:     }

24029:     function getMissionAccessibleDocuments(forceRefresh = false) {
24030:         const now = Date.now();
24031:         const cachedDocuments = mfMissionDocumentCache.documents;
24032: 
24033:         if (
24034:             !forceRefresh &&
24035:             now < mfMissionDocumentCache.expiresAt &&
24036:             cachedDocuments.every(isCachedMissionDocumentUsable)
24037:         ) {
24038:             return cachedDocuments;
24039:         }
24040: 
24041:         const documents = [];
24042: 
24043:         const addDocument = candidate => {
24044:             try {
24045:                 if (
24046:                     candidate &&
24047:                     candidate.documentElement &&
24048:                     !documents.includes(candidate)
24049:                 ) {
24050:                     documents.push(candidate);
24051:                 }
24052:             } catch (_error) {}
24053:         };
24054: 
24055:         addDocument(document);
24056: 
24057:         try {
24058:             addDocument(window.parent?.document);
24059:         } catch (_error) {}
24060: 
24061:         try {
24062:             addDocument(window.top?.document);
24063:         } catch (_error) {}

24066:

24078:                     } catch (_error) {}
24079:                 });
24080:             } catch (_error) {}
24081:         }
24082: 
24083:         mfMissionDocumentCache = {
24084:             expiresAt: now + 500,
24085:             documents
24086:         };
24087: 
24088:         return documents;
24089:     }

27037:     function isCarsToTowRequirementName(value) {
27038:         const cleaned = String(value || '')
27039:             .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
27040:             .trim();
27041: 
27042:         return /^(?:Required\s+)?(?:\d+\s+)?car(?:s)?\s+to\s+tow$/i.test(cleaned) ||

27044:     }

27046:     function getCarsToTowVehicleRequirement(unitName, carsRequired) {
27047:         if (!isCarsToTowRequirementName(unitName)) {
27048:             return null;
27049:         }
27050: 
27051:         const embeddedCount = String(unitName || '')
27052:             .replace(/,/g, '')
27053:             .match(/^(?:Required\s+)?(\d+)\s+car(?:s)?\s+to\s+tow$/i);
27054: 
27055:         const amountMatch = String(
27056:             embeddedCount ? embeddedCount[1] : (carsRequired ?? '')
27057:         )
27058:             .replace(/,/g, '')
27059:             .match(/\d+/);
27060: 
27061:         const cars = amountMatch
27062:             ? Math.max(0, parseInt(amountMatch[0], 10) || 0)
27063:             : 0;
27064: 
27065:         if (cars <= 0) {
27066:             return null;
27067:         }
27068: 
27069:         return {

27071:             carsRequired: cars,
27072:             stillNeeded: Math.ceil(cars / 2)
27073:         };
27074:     }

40664:         const duration = Number.isFinite(durationMs) ? durationMs : 26000;

40814:     async function resumeAutoAfterMainMissionOpen(reason) {
40815:         const started = Date.now();
40816: 
40817:         while (Date.now() - started < 45000) {
40818:             if (isManualAutoStopActive()) return false;
40819: 
40820:             if (isMissionPage() && isMissionScreenVisibleForQueueRestart()) {
40821:                 await waitForMissionReady();

40825:                 localStorage.setItem('mf_auto_mode_running', 'true');
40826:

40828:                     updateStatusBox('Mission opened. Auto Mode continuing...');
40829:                 } catch (error) {}
40830: 
40831:                 if (!autoModeLoopActive) {
40832:                     setTimeout(() => {
40833:                         if (
40834:                             autoModeRunning &&
40835:                             !autoModeLoopActive &&
40836:                             !isManualAutoStopActive()
40837:                         ) {
40838:                             runAutoModeLoop();
40839:                         }
40840:                     }, 100);
40841:                 }
40842: 
40843:                 return true;
40844:             }
40845: 
40846:             // A visible empty modal means MissionChief is still loading the mission.
40847:             // Keep waiting, but never open another mission over it.
40848:             if (hasVisibleQueueOpenModal(`resume-${reason}`)) {
40849:                 await wait(500);
40850:                 continue;
40851:             }
40852: 
40853:             // A direct mission URL may appear before the mission content.
40854:             if (/\/missions\/\d+/i.test(window.location.pathname)) {
40855:                 await wait(500);
40856:                 continue;
40857:             }
40858: 
40859:             await wait(500);
40860:         }
40861: 
40862:         if (mfDebugEnabled) {
40863:             debugLog(
40864:                 'MISSION OPEN OWNER',
40865:                 `${reason || 'unknown'} | mission content did not become ready within 45 seconds`
40866:             );
40867:         }

===== function isMissionScreenVisibleForQueueRestart() { | source lines 42553-42768 =====
42553: 
42554:     function realClickForQueueRestart(element) {
42555:         if (!element) return false;
42556: 
42557:         try {
42558:             element.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center', inline: 'center' });
42559:         } catch (error) {}
42560: 
42561:         try {
42562:             element.focus && element.focus({ preventScroll: true });
42563:         } catch (error) {}
42564: 
42565:         // One native click only.
42566:         // Sending several synthetic click sequences opened duplicate MissionChief modals.
42567:         try {
42568:             if (typeof element.click === 'function') {
42569:                 element.click();
42570:                 return true;
42571:             }
42572:         } catch (error) {}
42573: 
42574:         // Final fallback only when native click is unavailable.
42575:         try {
42576:             element.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', {
42577:                 bubbles: true,
42578:                 cancelable: true,
42579:                 composed: true,
42580:                 view: element.ownerDocument?.defaultView || window
42581:             }));
42582:             return true;
42583:         } catch (error) {
42584:             return false;
42585:         }
42586:     }

42588:     function isMissionScreenVisibleForQueueRestart() {
42589:         const missionInfo = document.querySelector('#mission_general_info');
42590:         const closeInside = document.querySelector('#lightbox_close_inside');
42591:         const insideContainer = document.querySelector('#iframe-inside-container');
42592: 
42593:         const closeInsideVisible = closeInside && isVisibleForQueueRestart(closeInside);
42594:         const insideContainerVisible = insideContainer && isVisibleForQueueRestart(insideContainer);
42595: 
42596:         if (!missionInfo) {
42597:             return !!closeInsideVisible || !!insideContainerVisible;
42598:         }
42599: 
42600:         const modal = missionInfo.closest('.vm--modal, .modal, .lightbox');
42601: 
42602:         if (modal && !isVisibleForQueueRestart(modal)) {
42603:             return !!closeInsideVisible || !!insideContainerVisible || isVisibleForQueueRestart(missionInfo);
42604:         }
42605: 
42606:         return isVisibleForQueueRestart(missionInfo) || !!modal || !!closeInsideVisible || !!insideContainerVisible;
42607:     }

46854:     function classifyMissionFinderMutations(records) {
46855:         const flags = {
46856:             relevant: false,
46857:             vehicleListChanged: false,
46858:             missionContextChanged: false,
46859:             patientChanged: false,
46860:             panelChanged: false,
46861:             transportChanged: false
46862:         };
46863: 
46864:         const inspectNode = node => {
46865:             if (!node || node.nodeType !== 1) return;
46866: 
46867:             if (
46868:                 node.matches?.(
46869:                     MF_MUTATION_PANEL_SELECTOR
46870:                 )
46871:             ) {
46872:                 flags.panelChanged = true;
46873:                 flags.relevant = true;
46874:                 return;
46875:             }
46876:

46878:                 node.closest?.(
46879:                     '#mission-finder-wrapper'
46880:                 )
46881:             ) {
46882:                 return;
46883:             }

46886:                 node,
46887:                 MF_MUTATION_RELEVANT_SELECTOR
46888:             )) {
46889:                 return;
46890:             }

46892:             if (mutationNodeMatches(
46893:                 node,
46894:                 MF_MUTATION_VEHICLE_SELECTOR
46895:             )) {
46896:                 flags.vehicleListChanged = true;
46897:                 flags.relevant = true;
46898:             }
46899: 
46900:             if (mutationNodeMatches(
46901:                 node,
46902:                 MF_MUTATION_MISSION_SELECTOR
46903:             )) {
46904:                 flags.missionContextChanged = true;
46905:                 flags.relevant = true;
46906:             }
46907: 
46908:             if (mutationNodeMatches(
46909:                 node,
46910:                 MF_MUTATION_PATIENT_SELECTOR
46911:             )) {
46912:                 flags.patientChanged = true;
46913:                 flags.relevant = true;
46914:             }
46915: 
46916:             if (mutationNodeMatches(
46917:                 node,
46918:                 MF_MUTATION_TRANSPORT_SELECTOR
46919:             )) {
46920:                 flags.transportChanged = true;
46921:                 flags.relevant = true;
46922:             }
46923:         };
46924: 
46925:         for (const record of records || []) {
46926: 
46927:             const target = record.target;
46928:             const changedNodes = [
46929:                 ...(record.addedNodes || []),
46930:                 ...(record.removedNodes || [])
46931:             ];
46932:             const hasPanelRootMutation =
46933:                 changedNodes.some(node =>
46934:                     node?.nodeType === 1 &&
46935:                     node.matches?.(
46936:                         MF_MUTATION_PANEL_SELECTOR
46937:                     )
46938:                 );
46939:             const targetOwned = mutationTargetWithin(
46940:                 target,
46941:                 '#mission-finder-wrapper'
46942:             );
46943: 
46944:             if (shouldIgnoreMissionFinderMutationRecord(
46945:                 targetOwned,
46946:                 hasPanelRootMutation
46947:             )) {
46948:                 continue;
46949:             }
46950: 
46951:             const targetRelevant = mutationTargetWithin(
46952:                 target,
46953:                 MF_MUTATION_RELEVANT_TARGET_SELECTOR
46954:             );
46955: 
46956:             if (
46957:                 targetRelevant &&
46958:                 mutationTargetWithin(
46959:                     target,
46960:                     MF_MUTATION_VEHICLE_SELECTOR
46961:                 )
46962:             ) {
46963:                 flags.vehicleListChanged = true;
46964:                 flags.relevant = true;
46965:             }
46966: 
46967:             if (
46968:                 targetRelevant &&
46969:                 mutationTargetWithin(
46970:                     target,
46971:                     MF_MUTATION_MISSION_TARGET_SELECTOR
46972:                 )
46973:             ) {
46974:                 flags.missionContextChanged = true;
46975:                 flags.relevant = true;
46976:             }
46977: 
46978:             if (
46979:                 targetRelevant &&
46980:                 mutationTargetWithin(
46981:                     target,
46982:                     MF_MUTATION_PATIENT_SELECTOR
46983:                 )
46984:             ) {
46985:                 flags.patientChanged = true;
46986:                 flags.relevant = true;
46987:             }
46988: 
46989:             if (
46990:                 targetRelevant &&
46991:                 mutationTargetWithin(
46992:                     target,
46993:                     MF_MUTATION_TRANSPORT_SELECTOR
46994:                 )
46995:             ) {

46997:                 flags.relevant = true;
46998:             }

47003:                 flags.vehicleListChanged &&

47005:                 flags.patientChanged &&
47006:                 flags.panelChanged &&
47007:                 flags.transportChanged

47010:             }
47011:         }

47013:         return flags;
47014:     }

22331:     async function waitForMissionReady() {
22332:         const timeoutMs = Math.max(4500, getMissionReadyDelay() + 2500);
22333:         const started = Date.now();
22334:         let stableSince = 0;
22335:         let lastDeepProbeAt = 0;
22336:         let hasPatientData = false;
22337:         let hasUpdateRows = false;
22338: 
22339:         while (Date.now() - started < timeoutMs) {
22340:             const hasMission = isMissionPage();
22341:             const hasUnits = !!document.querySelector('a[search_attribute]');
22342:             const hasMissionHelp = !!getMissionRequirementSource();
22343:             const hasBasicMissionUi = hasMission && hasUnits && hasMissionHelp;
22344: 
22345:             if (hasBasicMissionUi) {
22346:                 if (!stableSince) stableSince = Date.now();
22347: 
22348:                 const now = Date.now();
22349: 
22350:                 if (now - lastDeepProbeAt >= 300) {
22351:                     lastDeepProbeAt = now;
22352:                     hasPatientData = findPatientCount(true) > 0;
22353:                     hasUpdateRows = readMissionUpdateRows({
22354:                         silent: true
22355:                     }).length > 0;
22356:                 }
22357: 
22358:                 // Give dynamic patient cards at least 1.5 seconds after the
22359:                 // basic mission controls appear. They often render later.
22360:                 if (
22361:                     hasPatientData ||
22362:                     hasUpdateRows ||
22363:                     Date.now() - stableSince >= 650
22364:                 ) {
22365:                     break;
22366:                 }
22367:             } else {
22368:                 stableSince = 0;
22369:                 hasPatientData = false;
22370:                 hasUpdateRows = false;
22371:             }
22372: 
22373:             await wait(150);
22374:         }
22375: 
22376:         const configuredDelay = getMissionReadyDelay();
22377:         const finalReadyDelay =
22378:             hasPatientData || hasUpdateRows
22379:                 ? Math.min(configuredDelay, 350)
22380:                 : configuredDelay;
22381: 
22382:         await wait(finalReadyDelay);
22383:         requireMissionUpdateFirstPass('mission ready / content refreshed');
22384:     }

43961:         // The correct action is the first visible green "Approach" button in that table.
43962:         const exactApproachButton = findExactFirstApproachTransportButton();
